d:
Long, voluminous midnight black hair that reaches the waist. Cold, narrow crimson red eyes. Apparent age of twenty-five with a sophisticated, mature demeanor. Slender and curvaceous build. A complex black and dark grey gothic-style dress with intricate white lace trimmings and a large black bow. A dark gothic headdress and a floating, ornate black mechanical rigging.
BODY COLOR: pale porcelain
